Strategy: Spend a bin with a near-twin. If another bin has almost the same residual, using this one costs little, since a similar slot remains; a unique residual is worth preserving. Score by leftover with a bonus when another bin sits within a quarter item of this residual, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a twinned bin. It may help by preserving rare sizes, but may fail by favoring crowded sizes future items never need.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if sum([1 for s in bins if abs(s - r) <= item // 4]) >= 2 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Near-twin bonus: +item when another bin's residual is within item/4.
